description: The settings window: it names itself after the page it shows and is the only window that changes the config, the children, the login, the setup's account and pipeline connection, the model, Start at login and the setup's backup and import (and it opens the library at the recycle bin after the first sync), and the only one that opens the folder picker (for the Markdown folder, the backup folder and the .snbak file; the plugin has no narrower permission, the window asks for a folder or a backup file). Start at login goes through Rust commands, so no window gets the autostart plugin's permissions. It saves the notification choices and reads the permission of macOS through Rust commands. It follows events and shows the app version on the About page, where it checks for an update and installs it through Rust commands (no window gets the updater plugin's permissions). It ends an OCR pause on the OCR page; the menu bar and the panel pause the OCR and end a pause through Rust.
